sources.title: Matangi Tonga, Tonga’s 11 public holidays set for 2026 (17 November 2025), quoting the Prime Minister’s Office
sources.said: Most of the public holidays will be observed on the date of occurance. However, the Emancipation Day (June 4), and Anniversary of the Coronation of HM King George Tupou I (December 4), are observed on different dates, since they fall upon a Thursday and Friday. In accordance with section 2 of the Public Holidays Act, they will be celebrated on the following Mondays. Meanwhile, the Constitutional Day (November 4) that falls on a Wednesday, will be celebrated on the Monday before the actual date of occurance. Thursday, 1 January, New Year’s Day; Friday, 3 April, Good Friday; Monday, 6 April, Easter Monday; Saturday, 25 April, ANZAC Day; Monday, 8 June, Emancipation Day; Saturday, 4 July, Official Birthday of His Majesty, King Tupou VI; Thursday, 17 September, Birthday of HRH The Crown Prince Tupouto’a ‘Ulukalala; Monday, 2 November, Constitutional Day (National Day); Monday, 7 December, Anniversary of the Coronation of H.M King George Tupou I; Friday, 25 December, Christmas Day; Saturday, 26 December, Boxing Day.

sources.title: Matangi Tonga, Special public holiday to commemorate Centennial of Queen Salote College (9 March 2026)
sources.said: Tonga will observe a one-off government public holiday on Thursday, 12 March 2026, to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the establishment of Queen Salote College (QSC).

sources.title: Office Holidays, Tonga: bicentennial of Christianity public holiday 2026, quoting the Prime Minister’s Office
sources.said: Tonga will observe a special public holiday on Friday June 26th 2026 to commemorate the bicentennial anniversary of the introduction and establishment of Christianity in the Kingdom of Tonga. This declaration was approved by the Cabinet in accordance with Section 2(b) of the Public Holidays Act.
